title: 90-Second Minesweeper
description: Flag all 20 hidden mines on a 10x10 minefield before the 90-second clock runs out in this fast, free Minesweeper game for desktop and mobile.
about:
90-Second Minesweeper takes the classic logic puzzle and adds a ticking clock. The 10x10 board hides 20 mines, and every number you uncover tells you how many of them touch that square. Read the clues, mark the mines with flags and clear the field in a minute and a half.

The pressure changes how you play. There is no time to overthink every corner, so you learn to spot safe patterns quickly and trust your deductions. Your first square is always safe and opens up an area to start from, and tapping a finished number clears its remaining neighbours in one go. Uncover a mine or let the clock reach zero and the game ends, showing where every bomb was hidden. A little emoji face reacts to each move, from nervous to cool when you win, and your best winning time is saved.

The board grows to fill any screen, from a big monitor to a phone held either way, and works just as well with a mouse or a finger.
howToPlay: Reveal squares to uncover numbers that show how many mines touch that square; empty areas open up automatically and the first square is always safe. Mark mines with flags: you win when all 20 mines are flagged correctly or every safe square has been revealed. Click or tap a number whose mines are all flagged to open the rest of its neighbours. Revealing a mine or letting the 90 seconds run out ends the game; the face button starts a new board.

controls.action: Make taps place flags instead of revealing
Open its neighbours when all its mines are flagged

tips: Your first square is always safe and opens an area, so start near the middle.
A 1 touching only one hidden square means that square is a mine, so flag it right away.
Once a number has all its mines flagged, tap it to clear the rest of its neighbours in one move.
On a phone, switch on Flag mode when you have many flags to place in a row.
The bar under the counters drains with the clock and turns red in the last 15 seconds.

faq.question: Is 90-Second Minesweeper free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. It is completely free and runs in your browser with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play it on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. Tap a square to reveal it and long-press to place or remove a flag, or turn on Flag mode so every tap places a flag. The board resizes to fill the screen in portrait and landscape.

faq.question: How do I win?
faq.answer: Flag all 20 mines correctly, or reveal every safe square, before the 90 seconds run out. Your best winning time is saved in your browser.
